from.name: RFP Bid Non-Disclosure Agreement
from.description: A one-way NDA a supplier signs before receiving Fontara's RFP pack.

body.p: Fontara, Inc. ("Fontara") will give the Supplier the RFP pack and related information ("Confidential Information") only so the Supplier can prepare a bid.

The Supplier shall use the Confidential Information only to prepare its bid, keep it confidential with at least reasonable care, and share it only with its employees and advisers who need it for the bid and are bound by similar duties.
If the Supplier does not bid, or Fontara does not award it the contract, the Supplier shall destroy the Confidential Information on request.
These obligations last three years from signature. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. It creates no obligation to award a contract.
